recommendation: Test SearchApi for ads/trends first, then a bounded Apify social pilot. Obtain separate audience-panel product/API access before offering representative audience measurements.

providers.name: SearchApi
providers.purpose: Meta and Google ad-library data; Google search-interest trends.
providers.publishedPricing: 100 free requests advertised; Developer plan lists USD 40/month for 10,000 searches. Pagination and detail requests must be included in the usage budget.
nextSteps: The owner creates the account; SearchApi terms require a human registrant.
Verify coverage against known Indian advertisers and retain original attribution and source links.
Confirm commercial embedding/redistribution rights for the intended public product before rollout; an API subscription is not a blanket content license.
Store any key only as a server-side secret; add bounded queries, rate limits, usage accounting and explicit unavailable states.
providers.limitations: Provider retrieval has not been tested. Ad-library records are not proof of spend, conversions or campaign effectiveness. Available transparency fields vary.

providers.name: Apify
providers.purpose: Trial public social posts, profiles and comments using selected Actors.
providers.publishedPricing: Free plan advertises USD 5/month usage credit. Starter lists USD 19/month plus pay-as-you-go. Each Actor has its own result/event/usage pricing; no all-network flat-price assumption.
nextSteps: Select specific Actors and validate bounded samples, output fields, dates and source URLs.
Check usage rights, geographic/language coverage, costs and reliability before enabling public queries.
Build sentiment only over collected evidence, with a disclosed sample size and method.
providers.limitations: A social collection sample is neither exhaustive listening nor a representative audience panel. No Actor was run in this review.

providers.name: GWI
providers.publishedPricing: The pricing page distinguishes ordinary user plans from enterprise product/API integration. Product-embedding API terms and price need a direct quote; do not assume a free or Plus seat grants redistribution rights.
nextSteps: Confirm API availability, India coverage, methodology, allowed product use and commercial terms directly with GWI.
providers.limitations: No panel API or license is connected. Open-web summaries must remain labeled separately from panel measurements.
